svg.title: Compaction: keep the history inside the context window
svg.desc: Compaction runs in the before_model_request hook, between the message history and the model. TieredCompaction runs its tiers in order: DeduplicateFileReads and ClearToolResults cost no model call, SummarizingCompaction makes one. After each tier it re-measures the history and stops as soon as it fits target_tokens, so in this example the summary tier never runs. The shortened history persists into the run.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
